description: Train Station Usage is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office for Rail Regulation. National rail statistics Estimates of station usage figures are derived from ticket sales data recorded in rail industry systems. Eurostar and Heathrow Express are not included in rail industry systems. Travel using Oyster pay-as-you-go has been included from January 2010. Previously, Oyster pay-as-you-go journeys were not included in Station Usage figures. Coverage: Office for Rail Regulation. The publisher named on the listing is Office for Rail Regulation. Its keywords include entries, railway, overground, national, orr, network-rail. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
